C0238.title: Blogger Sentenced for Profiting from Unauthorized Derivative Works Using Unreleased Game Content
C0238.summary: In June 2023, a blogger was arrested for illegally obtaining unreleased game skin videos, creating derivative works, and posting them on short-video platforms to attract approximately 400,000 followers and generate profit. The individual was sentenced to three years in prison and fined 300,000 yuan.
